svg.title: Deploy with Terraform
svg.desc: Deployment ownership, not a runtime or network diagram. Protected Blob state and approved private deployment access are supplied separately. The platform Terraform stack owns Foundry, model deployments, networking, identities, backing services, and private diagnostics. The separate Lab Terraform stack references platform resources by reviewed IDs and names and owns internal Container Apps hosting, its registry and runtime identity, application Cosmos schema, monitoring, and optional alert email delivery. Image builds, agent publication, route verification, recovery, and approved quality checks remain separate release steps. No additional gateway, enterprise landing zone, or production readiness is implied.
svg.text: Separate infrastructure ownership from code releases

g.text: Protected Blob state + approved private deployment access
Separate platform and Lab state keys; Entra authentication.
Supplied separately, not created by the stacks below.
Foundry account, project, and model deployment
Private network, identities, and backing services
Private monitoring; APIM and the admin VM are optional.
Private Container Apps, registry, and runtime identity
Optional email action group; no recipients by default.
Build images and pin the Lab digest.
Publish agent versions; verify and recover routes.
Run smoke checks and approved quality evaluations.
A successful deployment does not prove answer quality.

svg.text: Each stack keeps its own state. Review plans before applying.
